value.rationale: The exact all-odd-power positivity horizon is a natural completed-output reliability criterion for repeated Crank–Nicolson star diffusion; it quantifies how allowable individual steps depend on parity and completed horizon, and identifies the unique site of failure. A four-vertex-path counterexample demonstrates an essential structural boundary. No stagewise SSP or accuracy claim is made.
